decision: Reuse the already validated PlotLines API, ring offset and scaling; no dependency change or copied source.
modifications: Project adapter disables plot input and permits overlap so the existing node editor owns body dragging. A bounded project cache owns evaluated graph IDs, playback/reset lifetime and numeric history.
validation: Real ImGui drag/link/pan and thousand-node regressions; actual Studio D3D11 component previews; Windows and USB Android evaluated signal history contracts.
